episode_summary: In this episode, Chris Wands shares his journey from handling small rental deals to leading a top-performing luxury real estate team. He emphasizes the importance of treating every transaction as an opportunity, leveraging technology like CRM systems, and maintaining a work-life balance. Chris also provides insights into building a successful team and the long-term value of small deals.
